results.title: ENG-SPEC-0417 ED-26 HV battery thermal management

storage.value:
Purpose

This specification defines how the battery management system (BMS) keeps the ED-26 high-voltage battery packs in their operating window.

Temperature windows

ConditionCell module temperature
Operation-25 to 55 °C
Target during DC charging25 to 35 °C
Preconditioning heater2 x 7 kW PTC heaters

Alarm thresholds

SignalThresholdReaction
Cell temperature spread> 8 KFC-BAT-2201 warning
Cell temperature spread> 12 KDC charging limited to 50 kW
Cell temperature spread> 15 KCharging stopped
Coolant flow< 12 L/min (nominal 18 L/min)FC-EAX-1310, eAxle power reduced

Software

BMS-3.2.1 raises the coolant pump speed at cold start and starts cooling 2 minutes earlier during DC charging.

results.title: ENG-SPEC-0422 DTE-13 SCR AdBlue dosing system

storage.value:
Purpose

Requirements for the selective catalytic reduction (SCR) dosing system of the DTE-13 engine.

Operating values

ParameterValue
Dosing pressure, nominal5.0 bar ± 0.3 bar
FC-ADB-0412 thresholdbelow 3.5 bar for more than 60 s
AdBlue urea concentration32.5 % (31.8 to 33.2 %)
Dosing line heater resistance2.5 to 3.5 ohm at 20 °C

Derate strategy

Step 1: torque limited to 75 % while FC-ADB-0412 is active. Step 2: 20 km/h limp mode after the next engine stop.

Engineering change

Engineering change ECN-2026-0131 introduced the revised dosing valve PN 47-0118-334 from production week 14/2026.

Partitions

The TCU-5 has two software partitions, A and B. An update is written to the inactive partition, so the vehicle always keeps one working version.

Update stages

ProgressStage
0 to 50 %Download while driving
50 to 60 %Signature verification; needs the time within ±5 minutes from GNSS or the backend
60 to 95 %Installation to the inactive partition, ignition off
95 to 100 %Activation and self-test

Rollback

If the self-test fails, the TCU-5 switches back to the previous partition and reports the failure to the backend.
